_comment: Methodology constants from research/batch1/02_methodology.md §7. Each triple is [P5, P50, P95] treated as lognormal. methodology_version bumps on any formula change.
_u_fleet_note: Fleet-median utilization factor: converts benchmark throughput-batched eta to fleet-median serving reality. Evidence: Google fleet back-out eta ~4-6 pJ/FLOP vs batched 2.5 (research/batch2/02 §1); ML.ENERGY batch sensitivity 3-5x; Oviedo node power P5-P95 = 40-90% of max. NOT applied to sram_dataflow rows (their speed_premium already embodies utilization).
_lambda_think_note: NOT applied in factors; factors are per billed/visible token. Apply lambda_think at estimate time only when a provider hides thinking tokens AND the request used reasoning.
